paper_title: An analysis of vaccine-related sentiments from development to deployment   of COVID-19 vaccines
caption: : Polarity scores for Japan
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the distribution of polarity scores for Japan related to COVID-19 vaccines. The x-axis, labeled "Polarity scores", is a linear scale ranging from -1.0 to 0.6 with tick intervals of 0.05. The y-axis, labeled “Counts”, ranges from 0 to approximately 40,000, with tick intervals of 2,000. A single blue line, displayed with a solid line style and circular markers, begins at a count of approximately 30 at polarity score -1.0, decreases to a count of approximately 5,000 at polarity score -0.6, rises to a peak of approximately 28,000 at polarity score -0.2, subsequently declines to approximately 22,000 at polarity score 0.0, and then rises to approximately 39,000 at polarity score 0.6.
